title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy object-src allows every origin
description: The policy let an object element load from anywhere. Object content is not ordinary markup: it is handed to a plugin or a nested browsing context with different isolation rules, and that is exactly the surface modern browsers have been retiring. The finding is the unbounded object origin list, in contrast to the rule that reports the directive being absent.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Legacy plugin and object content from an untrusted origin; MEDIUM severity.
